key_facts.fact: Chest pain worse with exertion for three days
History of hypertension and high cholesterol
Follow up in clinic in one month

reference_summary: 67-year-old male with chest pain worse with exertion for three days. History of hypertension and high cholesterol. Vitals BP 142/88, HR 78. Labs LDL 160, A1c 6.1. ECG normal sinus rhythm. Plan: start aspirin and atorvastatin, stress test within two weeks, clinic follow-up in one month.

key_facts.fact: Type 2 diabetes with A1c 8.2, up from 7.4

reference_summary: 94-year-old female with type 2 diabetes, A1c 8.2 rising from 7.4, increased thirst and frequent urination. On metformin 1000 mg twice daily. Plan: add DPP-4 inhibitor, diabetes education referral, recheck A1c in three months.

key_facts.fact: Migraine headaches two to three times per month
Neurologic exam normal, no focal deficits

reference_summary: 45-year-old male with migraine headaches two to three times per month for two years. Neurologic exam normal. Partial relief with ibuprofen. Plan: sumatriptan 50 mg as needed, headache diary, follow up in three months.
